title: Graduate Engineer - Water Infrastructure
content_text:
Global engineering consultancy with genuine career development opportunities
Graduate opportunity for immediate start, Traralgon 
Hybrid work environment with attractive benefits and professional development opportunities
About SMEC
SMEC has joined forces with Surbana Jurong to provide global engineering and consultancy expertise in urban, infrastructure and management advisory. Our new partnership has created a talent pool of 13,000 dedicated people working across a network of 100 offices in 40 countries.
The role
We are seeking a recent 
Graduate
 
Civil Engineer 
with a keen desire to build a long-term career in 
Water Infrastructure
 to join our 
 Traralgon
  team.
Our Water team provides end-to-end solutions across the full water cycle, including major pipelines, large-scale pumping stations, and advanced water, wastewater, and recycling treatment facilities.
Graduate Development Program
Contribute to major projects and community initiatives
Gain hands-on experience in proposals, reports, and technical documentation
Access mentoring, networking, and industry events
Participate in tailored workshops and training
You will be given the opportunity for both in-person and online training on everything from consulting with clients to managing your time effectively through our graduate development workshops.
About You
Recent 
Civil 
Engineering graduate (within 2 years) with a credit average
A keen desire to build a long-term career in water infrastructure with an international consultancy
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Ability to manage time and workload effectively
Knowledge of analytical methods and engineering principles
In return, SMEC offers you the benefits that come from working in a global multidisciplinary consultancy in an environment where your fresh ideas and enthusiasm will be welcomed and rewarded.
How to Apply
To be considered please submit your application online with:
Cover letter
Resume
Academic transcript
To find out more about SMEC, please visit our careers page at 
www.smec.com/careers
All recruitment activities go through our Resourcing function and currently, this role doesn’t require agency input. Please do not forward resumes directly to SMEC employees/managers; we do not accept unsolicited resumes and are not responsible for any associated fees.
At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
apply_instructions: Apply online via the SMEC Workday careers portal. Include CV and academic transcript.
